name: partnercentral-account
description: AWS Partner Central Account service provides APIs for managing partner accounts, connections, and profiles within the AWS Partner Network.

subcommands.name: accept-connection-invitation
subcommands.description: Accepts a connection invitation from another partner, establishing a formal partnership connection between the two parties.

subcommands.name: associate-aws-training-certification-email-domain
subcommands.description: Associates an email domain with AWS training and certification for the partner account, enabling automatic verification of employee certifications.

subcommands.name: cancel-connection
subcommands.description: Cancels an existing connection between partners, terminating the partnership relationship.

subcommands.name: cancel-connection-invitation
subcommands.description: Cancels a pending connection invitation before it has been accepted or rejected.

subcommands.name: cancel-profile-update-task
subcommands.description: Cancels an in-progress profile update task, stopping any pending changes to the partner profile.

subcommands.name: create-connection-invitation
subcommands.description: Creates a new connection invitation to establish a partnership with another organization.

subcommands.name: create-partner
subcommands.description: Creates a new partner account in the AWS Partner Network with the specified details and configuration.

subcommands.name: disassociate-aws-training-certification-email-domain
subcommands.description: Removes the association between an email domain and AWS training and certification for the partner account.

subcommands.name: get-alliance-lead-contact
subcommands.description: Retrieves the alliance lead contact information for a partner account.

subcommands.name: get-connection
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific connection between partners.

subcommands.name: get-connection-invitation
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific connection invitation.

subcommands.name: get-connection-preferences
subcommands.description: Retrieves the connection preferences for a partner account, including access settings and exclusions.

subcommands.name: get-partner
subcommands.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific partner account.

subcommands.name: get-profile-update-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves information about a specific profile update task.

subcommands.name: get-profile-visibility
subcommands.description: Retrieves the visibility settings for a partner profile, determining who can see the profile information.

subcommands.name: get-qualifications-association-details
subcommands.description: Returns your current qualifications association status, the primary partner, and the full list of partners associated under the primary partner.

subcommands.name: get-qualifications-association-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status and details of the most recent qualifications association task for your partner account.

subcommands.name: get-qualifications-disassociation-task
subcommands.description: Retrieves the status and details of the most recent qualifications disassociation task for your partner account.

subcommands.name: get-verification
subcommands.description: Retrieves the current status and details of a verification process for a partner account.

subcommands.name: list-connection-invitations
subcommands.description: Lists connection invitations for the partner account, with optional filtering by status, type, and other criteria.

subcommands.name: list-connections
subcommands.description: Lists active connections for the partner account, with optional filtering by connection type and participant.

subcommands.name: list-partners
subcommands.description: Lists partner accounts in the catalog, providing a summary view of all partners.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all tags associated with a specific AWS Partner Central Account resource.

subcommands.name: put-alliance-lead-contact
subcommands.description: Creates or updates the alliance lead contact information for a partner account.

subcommands.name: put-profile-visibility
subcommands.description: Sets the visibility level for a partner profile, controlling who can view the profile information.

subcommands.name: reject-connection-invitation
subcommands.description: Rejects a connection invitation from another partner, declining the partnership request.

subcommands.name: send-email-verification-code
subcommands.description: Sends an email verification code to the specified email address for account verification purposes.

subcommands.name: start-profile-update-task
subcommands.description: Initiates a profile update task to modify partner profile information asynchronously.

subcommands.name: start-qualifications-association-task
subcommands.description: Initiates an asynchronous task to associate your partner qualifications with a primary account.

subcommands.name: start-qualifications-disassociation-task
subcommands.description: Initiates an asynchronous task to disassociate your partner qualifications from a primary account.

subcommands.name: start-verification
subcommands.description: Initiates a new verification process for a partner account.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Adds or updates tags for a specified AWS Partner Central Account resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes specified tags from an AWS Partner Central Account resource.

subcommands.name: update-connection-preferences
subcommands.description: Updates the connection preferences for a partner account, modifying access settings and exclusions.
